description: This file defines an enumeration for canvas A2UI commands and two structures representing parameters for push operations in the A2UI system. It appears to be part of a shared toolkit for rendering and managing A2UI content on a device canvas.

methods.name: init(messages: [AnyCodable])
methods.description: Initializes an OpenClawCanvasA2UIPushParams instance with specified messages.

methods.name: init(jsonl: String)
methods.description: Initializes an OpenClawCanvasA2UIPushJSONLParams instance with JSONL string.
